items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Bill Russell already talked to you once

ctx.x: All right. So, let's see, what we're going to talk about. Bill Russell already talked to you once, so I just wanted to follow up on it and ask you a few questions about your relatives. I never did understand. You had a cousin or an uncle or something. What was his name? Batiste that played? Oh, yeah. Joe Batiste. Mm-hmm. He was a banjo player. What kin was he to you? Huh? He was kin to you? Yeah, that was my cousin. Your cousin, huh? Mm-hmm. And you had a lot of other cousins and in-laws and everything that…
Well, Joe Batiste played and John played and John got Sam Casme played and William Casme played. Those were John's brothers? All my first cousins, yeah. Yeah.
